chunks: Those who accept the faith, then disbelieve, then return to it, and deny once again and increase in disbelief, will not be forgiven by God or be guided by Him.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of alternating between faith and disbelief in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the progression from initial faith to 'al-kunf' (firmness in disbelief) through repeated apostasy, distinguishing it from simple hypocrisy by its final state of entrenched rejection. Scholars note that the divine promise of no forgiveness applies specifically to those who reach this stage of confirmed disbelief after having known the truth, emphasizing the gravity of willful, persistent rejection.
